As a class of artificially engineered functional materials, metamaterials attain extraordinary properties inaccessible to natural substances through rationally designed artificial architectures and have thus emerged as a prominent branch of the broader materials family. Moreover, they offer a completely novel methodological framework for materials research, thereby driving a paradigm shift in materials science. Building on this new paradigm, we propose a novel subdiscipline of materials science, namely metamaterialogy, whose scope extends far beyond metamaterials themselves to span the entire realm of materials research. It is promising to break through the performance limits of conventional materials and develop advanced materials that integrate the advantages of both metamaterials and conventional materials via their coupling by leveraging the fundamental principles underpinning this academic subdiscipline.

Ethical approval was not required for this study, as it did not involve the collection of primary data from human participants or animals. The research was based exclusively on the analysis of publicly available documents and aggregated secondary data.

## Informed consent

Informed consent was not applicable to this study, as it did not involve direct interaction with human participants or the collection of identifiable personal data.

## Competing interests

The author declares no competing interests.

# Data Availability

The data underlying this study consists of the publicly available policy, programmatic, statistical, and institutional documents that were systematically identified, screened, and analysed as part of the structured document review. A complete list of the 52 documents included in the study, together with access information, is provided in Dataset 1. All documents are available from official government, institutional, or organizational sources via the links provided. Where access is restricted, details on how the materials may be obtained are indicated in the supplementary file.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
